description: This file implements a regression testing suite for live cache behavior of AI models, including functions to run cache probes, compare against baselines, and generate regression reports. It references external modules for model resolution, cache baseline data, and support functions for message handling and logging.

methods.name: makeUserTurn
methods.description: Creates a user message object with current timestamp.

methods.name: makeImageUserTurn
methods.description: Creates a user message with an attached image in base64 format.

methods.name: makeToolResultMessage
methods.description: Constructs a tool result message with specified tool call ID, name, and text.

methods.name: extractFirstToolCall
methods.description: Extracts the first 'toolCall' block from an assistant message.

methods.name: normalizeCacheUsage
methods.description: Normalizes cache usage data from assistant message usage info.

methods.name: resolveBaselineFloor
methods.description: Resolves baseline floor data for a given provider and lane.

methods.name: assert
methods.description: Asserts a condition, throws error with message if false.

methods.name: runToolOnlyTurn
methods.description: Executes a turn where only a tool call is expected, retries if necessary.

methods.name: completeCacheProbe
methods.description: Performs a cache probe and returns cache hit/miss info.

methods.name: runRepeatedLane
methods.description: Runs cache probe multiple times for a specific lane and provider, returning best/warmup results.

methods.name: runAnthropicDisabledLane
methods.description: Runs a cache probe for an 'anthropic-disabled' lane.

methods.name: formatUsage
methods.description: Formats cache usage data into a string.

methods.name: assertAgainstBaseline
methods.description: Checks cache results against baseline thresholds and records regressions.

methods.name: runLiveCacheRegression
methods.description: Main function to perform live cache regression testing across multiple models and lanes, producing a summary and regressions list.
